newsitem.title: UK: NWE gasoline firm with futures, ARA supply good.
newsitem.headline: NWE gasoline firm with futures, ARA supply good.

text.p: NWE gasoline was firmer on Wednesday as futures staged another rally, traders said.
Eurograde barges traded at $218 fob ARA in the morning and then changed hands at $222. ARA supply was seen healthy.
U.S. numbers were looking healthy for arbitrage opportunities although no deals were heard done.
A U.K. refiner was heard holding some lower octane barrels which could be suitable for north American markets.
MTBE traded at $282 and possibly $285 fob ARA, while in Lavera a very small piece traded at $285, delivered in pipe.
